description: Source code for an authentication API router in a FastAPI project. Defines endpoints for sign-up, verification, sign-in, password reset, and related operations. Handles user management through a unified 'public.users' table and interactions with external services like Supabase and email service. Implements rate limiting and includes internal helper functions for user data management.

methods.name: SignUpResponse signup( payload: SignUpRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Endpoint to initiate user signup: generates verification code, stores pending state, and sends verification email.

methods.name: None send_verification_code( payload: SendVerificationCodeRequest, request: Request, email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Endpoint to send or resend email verification code for a user.

methods.name: None verify_code( payload: VerifyCodeRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Endpoint to verify user's email using a code, marking email as verified upon success.

methods.name: AuthTokenResponse signin( payload: SignInRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate user and return access token.

methods.name: None forgot_password( payload: ForgotPasswordRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Endpoint to initiate password reset process by sending a reset code via email.

methods.name: None reset_password( payload: ResetPasswordRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Endpoint to reset password given a valid reset code.
